_source: STVV ticketing (stvv.roboticket.com), seat data for event 4758 (STVV - KRC Genk), read 21 Nov 2026 from the logged-in seat map. 12,423 seats in total; the map's coordinates are schematic (a uniform 150-unit seat grid), so only the topology is used: block order, rows, seat labels and gaps.
_format: Per tier: blocks in order along the stand; 'rows' maps a row or row range to the seat labels present, in runs. Labels are laid out from the seat-1 end of the block, one seat pitch per label, so a missing label leaves an empty place. 'gaps_after' marks a label after which the ticketing map shows a physical gap (a stair inside the block). Rows missing from a block inside the tier's row range are tunnel mouths where 'tunnels' is true.
_not_modelled: WEST/W (5 rows x 100, rows labelled 1-100 to 401-499, in front of the north half of West), the skyboxes, office boxes and lounges (2 rows of 7-14 each), ZUID (M, N1-N4: the demolished stand) and the PITCH sector (50 places).

east-0._orientation: blocks run north to south (A at the north end); seat 1 is at the north end of each row; row 1 at the front

north-0._orientation: blocks run west to east (X1 at the west end); seat 1 is at the east end of each row; row 1 at the front

west-0._orientation: blocks run north to south (V1 at the north end); seat 1 is at the north end of each row; row 1 at the front

west-1._orientation: as West lower. SR2 is the press area: rows 3 and 5 hold no seats (desk rows) and rows 4 and 6 are partly seated
